skill.name: frontend-aesthetics
skill.description: Use when creating UI designs that need a distinctive, polished visual system. Guides typography, color, motion, backgrounds, hierarchy, and practical UI refinement for branded frontend work.
skill.summary: Guides distinctive frontend UI aesthetics for landing pages, dashboards, and branded interfaces.
skill.author: Barnhardt-Enterprises-Inc

content.value_statement: Generic frontend screens often look similar and miss brand focus. This skill guides typography, color, motion, and depth choices for clearer interfaces.
actual_capabilities: Identifies common generic UI patterns and suggests more distinctive alternatives.
Provides typography guidance for headings, body text, code, and hierarchy.
Recommends focused color systems with true dark bases and clear accent usage.
Offers motion patterns for hover states, page entry, modals, lists, and data updates.
Gives component styling examples for dashboards, buttons, tables, cards, and forms.
Includes a checklist for reviewing typography, colors, motion, depth, and hierarchy.
limitations: Does not inspect screenshots or run visual tests by itself.
Does not create a full brand strategy or naming system.
Focuses on frontend aesthetics, not backend code or test implementation.
External resource links are references and are not fetched automatically.

use_cases.title: Polish a Product Dashboard
use_cases.description: Improve data density, hierarchy, dark surfaces, hover states, and status indicators for a dashboard interface.

use_cases.title: Review a Landing Page Direction
use_cases.description: Find generic visual choices and replace them with stronger typography, focused accents, and useful motion.

use_cases.title: Build a Branded UI Kit
use_cases.description: Create practical rules for fonts, colors, components, icons, backgrounds, and interaction states.

prompt_templates.title: Refresh a Simple Page
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a single screen.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the frontend-aesthetics skill to improve this page. Focus on typography, one accent color, background depth, and clear hierarchy.

prompt_templates.title: Review an Existing Interface
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate critique of current UI work.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this interface for generic visual patterns. List the highest impact design changes for fonts, colors, spacing, motion, and components.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Dashboard System
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a dashboard visual system using this skill. Define typography, dark surfaces, accent usage, table styling, status badges, and motion states.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Brand-Specific Direction
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the skill to create a distinctive frontend direction for this brand. Explain the visual rationale and give implementation guidance for key screens.

output_examples.input: Review a landing page that uses default fonts, a purple-to-blue gradient, and centered content.
output: Use a more distinctive heading font and keep the body font highly readable.
Replace the gradient-heavy accent treatment with one brand accent and restrained shadows.
Create a stronger layout rhythm with asymmetric alignment and clearer section hierarchy.

output_examples.input: Plan a dark dashboard for project monitoring.
output: Use a near-black base with slightly raised surfaces for cards and tables.
Reserve the primary accent for active states, main actions, and important metrics.
Add subtle hover transitions, loading states, and data update feedback.

output_examples.input: Improve a component library that feels inconsistent.
output: Standardize icon stroke style, corner radius, border opacity, and focus states.
Define separate treatments for primary, secondary, destructive, and disabled actions.
Review forms for persistent labels, specific validation messages, and readable contrast.

best_practices: Choose one primary accent color and use semantic colors only for clear status meanings.
Use distinctive typography for headings while keeping body text readable and accessible.
Add purposeful motion for state changes, loading, hover feedback, and page transitions.
anti_patterns: Avoid default font stacks as the main brand expression for polished interfaces.
Avoid purple-blue gradients, rainbow accents, and multiple primary buttons on one screen.
Avoid flat dark backgrounds, white cards on dark surfaces, and vague form error messages.

faq.question: What does this skill improve?
faq.answer: It improves visual direction for frontend pages, dashboards, branded components, and interface reviews.

faq.question: Does it generate complete application code?
faq.answer: No. It provides design guidance and implementation patterns that an agent can apply while building UI.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it require internet access?
faq.answer: No. It includes reference links, but the core guidance is contained in the skill files.

faq.question: Is it only for dark themes?
faq.answer: No. It emphasizes true dark examples, but the principles also apply to light branded interfaces.

faq.question: Can it replace a human designer?
faq.answer: No. It helps agents avoid generic choices, but product context and brand judgment still matter.
